verdict.rationale: Extend documents its own high-volume mechanisms: every processing endpoint supports an asynchronous mode, SDK polling helpers and webhooks are described for production workloads, and the CLI has a batch command. Nothing in the pack documents rate limits, throughput figures, or behavior at the millions-of-pages scale. missing for 10: documented rate limits/quotas, predictable throughput or SLA guarantees, evidence of millions-of-pages batch scale, independent corroboration of bulk performance.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I push high-volume batches — millions of pages — with documented rate limits and predictable throughput

citations.quote: Every processing endpoint in Extend (extract, classify, split, parse, and edit) supports both a synchronous and asynchronous mode.
